topics.title: Onion Lasalgaon mandi me aaj kya bhav hai? 10 Sep 2026
topics.content: Bhaiyon, maine aaj subah 8 baje Lasalgaon pahucha. Red onion Medium quality ka aaj opening ₹2,780/q hai, Superior ₹2,910/q. Kal se ₹40 ka softening hai — wait karna sahi rahega ya aaj hi bech du? Mera 22 quintal hai Nashik-Niphad se.

topics.title: KANDI PEST — Onion me kya karoon? 10 acre Nashik Sinnar
topics.content: Doston last 3 din se meri onion crop me yellow patches dikh rahe hain, niche patte chipak ke sookh rahe hain. Jab maine jad uthaya to chote chote kande white larva dikhe — lagta hai thrips + kandi attack. Abhi 45 din ka crop hai. Malathion + imidacloprid mix maarna chahiye ya single dose? Kitne din ke gap me 2 spray karni chahiye? Photo attach ki hai — jarur dekhiye.

topics.title: PM-KISAN + NSMNY total ₹12,000 — Mera abhi tak nahi aaya 1st installment
topics.content: Bhai log, maine June me PM-KISAN aur NSMNY dono ka form Gram Sevak ke through submit kar diya tha. Aadhaar + 7/12 + bank sab link karaya, biometric bhi. Lekin abhi tak mera pehla ₹4000 + ₹2000 installment account me nahi aaya. Aap sab logon ko kitne din me milta hai? Taluka office jaane ke liye minimum kitna din wait karna chahiye?

topics.title: SUCCESS: Mehnat + drip = 240 q/ha onion yield. 3 acre Sinnar
topics.content: Ek saal pehle main bhi rota tha — 80-90 q/ha bas. Phir PMKSY ke through 3 acre par drip + fertigation lagwaya (90% subsidy 👏). Schedule: Daily 35 min drip, NPK fertigation har 12 din. Jeevamrut monthly 2 spray. Result: Super quality onion 240 quintal per hectare. Pimpalgaon me sold @ ₹3,120/q. Mehnat + technology = sureshot. Shaam ko photo upload karunga — dekh lena.

topics.title: 5 HP Solar Pump — Magel Tyala Solar waiting kitne mahine ka?
topics.content: Bhaiyo maine 3 mahine pehle Magel Tyala Solar Yojana ke under 5 HP pump ke liye apply kiya (General category, 4 acre land, Jalgaon district). Abhi tak message hi nahi aaya selection ka. Kisi ko pata hai current waiting kitni chal rahi hai? Kya CSC agent ko kuch extra dena padta hai? (Nahi dena hai main — bas sach pooch raha hoon)

topics.title: Lasalgaon vs Pimpalgaon vs Chandwad — konsa mandi best onion ke liye aaj kal?
topics.content: Mera next week 45 quintal Superior grade onion ready hai. Pichhle saal Lasalgaon me gaya tha lekin late auction aur 2% deduction ka nuksan hua. Pimpalgaon me abhi commission kitna lete hain? Chandwad me unloading charge kitna hai? Aap sab ki recent experience — which one actually gives MORE money in hand? (NOT just announced price — NET realisation bolo)

topics.title: Rabi onion nursery kab karni chahiye Nashik region? 2026-27
topics.content: Bhaiyon confusion hai — kuch bol rahe hai 15 Oct se pehle, kuch bol rahe hai 25 Oct ke baad hi. Last year maine 20 Oct ko ki thi to bolting problem thi (garmi late chali thi). Soil health card se nitrogen kam tha, ab compost daal di hai 2 tractor per acre. EXACT window kya rahegi Rabi onion nursery + transplanting ke liye this time?

topics.title: Kisaan Credit Card ka 4% subsidy — actually milti hai ya nahi?
topics.content: Bank wale bolte hai 7% interest, 4% subsidy prompt repayment par milegi. 3 saal se main KCC use kar raha hoon, har wakt EMI / withdrawal time se pehle bharata hoon, lekin subsidy kabhi bank account me credit nahi hui. Kisi ko actual me ₹ kab mile hai? Kahan complaint karni chahiye — Branch ya Lead Bank Office?

topics.title: Soybean + Onion crop rotation — 2 year cycle successful here
topics.content: Soybean kharif (July-Nov) → Onion rabi (Nov-Apr) → 2 year repeat. 5 acre Sangamner. Soil improvement, no pest build up, good market price diversification. Soybean avg 24 q/acre @ ₹5,800/q; Onion avg 190 q/ha @ ₹2,800/q. Net per acre per year: approx ₹1.35 lakh (after all costs). Agar koi is pattern ko aur improve karna chahta hai — reply kare. NEMATODE problem kisi ko aayi hai is rotation me?

topics.title: Onion storage (chawl) kapde phene ya plastic? Nashik traditional
topics.content: Pura jila is problem me hai — barish ke baad humidity badh rahi hai. 400 q onion mera godown me pada hai. Traditionally hum kapde ka parda karte hain, lekin aaj kal logon ne plastic tarpaulin + exhaust fan lagaya hai. Kiska roti kitni din tak bachati hai? FUNGAL / BLACK ROT attack kis me zyada aaya aapke experience me? Koi desi upay jo 2 mahine tak 90%+ quality bachaye?

topics.title: OFFICIAL: PM-KISAN 14th installment released — check status now
topics.content: The 14th installment of PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi (₹2,000) has been released on 10 September 2026. All verified farmers with active Aadhaar-bank linking can check their status on pmkisan.gov.in under Farmer Corner. If your status shows 'FTO generated', the amount will be credited within 48 hours. For issues, contact your nearest CSC or call PM-KISAN helpline 1800-180-1551.

topics.title: Which onion variety gives best price — hybrid vs local red?
topics.content: I have been growing local red onion (Phule Manda) for 5 years. Yield is decent but the price gap between hybrid and local has grown to ₹400-600/q in Lasalgaon. Is it worth switching to hybrid varieties like Arka Kalyan or Mahashakti? My soil is black cotton, drip irrigated, 3 acre in Sangamner. Anyone tried both and compared actual net realization?

topics.title: 50 quintal Super Quality onion — looking for buyer in Pune/Mumbai
topics.content: Harvesting 50 quintal Super Quality red onion next week (20 Sep). Farm gate in Nashik-Niphad. Looking for direct buyer — no middleman. Can transport to Pune or Mumbai. Last 3 lots sold at ₹2,950/q at Pimpalgaon. Willing to negotiate for bulk. Quality photos available. Serious buyers DM or reply here.

topics.title: Offering: 2 HP borewell pump (used 1 season) — want drip set
topics.content: I have a 2 HP Kirloskar borewell pump used for just 1 season (Rabi 2025). Working perfectly, loaded with starter. Want to exchange for a drip irrigation set (4-5 acre capacity) or sell for ₹12,000. Located in Jalgaon. Anyone interested? Pump photos and purchase bill available. Can deliver within 30 km.

Thrips + purple blotch combo aagaya. Step 1: Fipronil 5% SC @ 1.5 ml/litre (only if thrips count > 5 per leaf). Step 2: Mancozeb 75% @ 2.5 g/litre blight ke liye. Step 3: 7 din gap doosra spray. Step 4: 3 spray me Imidacloprid 17.8% mat use karo — resistance aa gayi Nashik me. Last spray havest se 15 din pehle mat karna.

Sir ne sahi bola. Desi jugaad: 1 litre gaumutra + 200 gm neem cake 5 litre pani me 24 hr soak, filtrate karo, spray karo. Organic wale logo ke liye bahut kaam aata 60% control. Chemical sath me chala sakte if NOT selling immediate.
